title: Perrigo Company plc Completes Acquisition Of Omega Pharma Invest N.V., Creating A Top Five Global OTC Company
主要内容: Perrigo Company plc completed the acquisition of Omega Pharma Invest N.V. in a cash and equity transaction valued at approximately €3.8 billion, including €1.3 billion in debt. The acquisition creates a top 5 global OTC healthcare company by revenue. The transaction is expected to be immediately accretive, with fiscal 2016 adjusted earnings per share between $0.10 and $0.20 after adjusting for amortization, transaction, and financing costs. Omega generated approximately €1.27 billion of revenue and €200 million of operating cash flow in the year ended December 31, 2014. The Company expects to achieve increasing revenue and supply chain synergies in Europe, contributing greater than $125 million to gross profit in 2019. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Perrigo Company plc (PRGO).
